inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to finish renegotiating the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning of an indefinite nationwide strike if it does not. Workers should not have to threaten a shutdown to make long-delayed negotiations a priority. The dispute highlights how institutions can depend on workers’ labor while leaving their concerns unresolved; the government needs to engage seriously and reach a fair agreement before university staff are pushed further into confrontation.
